title: ARIN 58 Day 1 Recap
description: From Miami, Florida, ARIN 58 is underway! We were thrilled to open the doors to the meeting, and we thank everyone who was able to join us virtually.

title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
description: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

title: Your most pressing questions about ASPA, answered
description: Answering some of the most frequently asked questions about ASPA.

title: Turning IPv6 tunnels into programmable delay lines for pulsing DoS
description: Guest Post: TED shows how permissive tunnel decapsulation and inconsistent IPv6 Extension Header handling can focus low-rate traffic into short, high-rate bursts.

title: PHP Releases Emergency Security Patches as Researchers Report Exploit Attempts
description: PHP has released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities that could enable unauthenticated remote code execution. Security researchers report attempted exploitation, while authorities urge immediate updates across internet-facing hosting environments.

title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
description: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
description: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

title: Redesigning My Resources
description: We’re redesigning the My Resources page in the LIR Portal to help RIPE NCC members better understand and manage their Internet number resources. Clearer hierarchies, automated checks and practical guidance aim to make it easier to see what needs attention and keep registrations u…

title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
description: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.

title: DNA Progress, NIS2 Amendments, CSA 2.0 and More - EU Regulation Update October 2026
description: As sweeping regulatory files move through the legislative pipeline, co-legislators are actively shaping their positions in the European Parliament and Council. Meanwhile, the Commission keeps laying the groundwork for new initiatives ahead. Here’s our latest overview of key regul…

title: Rolling the root key: What happened?
description: The DNS root key was rolled on 11 October 2026. Was the key roll a success?

title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
description: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.

title: The Domain Trust Badge: Making Anti-Abuse Work Visible
description: The Domain Trust Badge pilot introduces a voluntary framework for registries and registrars to demonstrate effective anti-abuse practices through 17 requirements, evidence-based validation and a new metric measuring abuse mitigation performance.

title: Pakistan’s .PK Is Now DNSSEC-Signed, but Only One Domain Validates
description: Pakistan's .pk domain has gained DNSSEC protection, but an October 11 scan found just one fully validating domain among 158,561 examined. Another 1,230 signed domains lack the parent-zone records needed to establish trust.

title: Access Now Documents Years-Long Internet Shutdowns Across Conflict Regions
description: Access Now documents prolonged Internet shutdowns in Myanmar, Ethiopia and other conflict-affected regions, highlighting persistent connectivity restrictions, damaged telecommunications infrastructure and the difficulty of determining when meaningful access has been restored.

title: The Domain Industry’s Next Growth Phase Is About Value, Not Volume
description: The Global Domain Report 2026 points to a maturing domain market where sustainable growth increasingly depends on adoption, trust and commercial relevance rather than registration volumes alone.

title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
description: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

title: Being connected is not enough: Territorial inequalities in fixed-Internet access and performance
description: Guest Post: High aggregate Internet penetration can mask significant territorial inequalities. Using the Dominican Republic as a case study, this analysis shows that access and network performance vary widely across provinces, highlighting why the digital divide is about more tha…

title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
description: When our AI code reviewer's cost per run doubled, we dug into the token usage to find out why. Learn how we used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to slash our inference bill by 68% while speeding up reviews.

title: What ICANN’s Contention Sets Reveal About New gTLD Values
description: ICANN's Reveal Day list holds 263 contention sets. With private deals banned this round, any set that reaches an ICANN auction will end in a public price. The 2012 auctions show why the number of bidders is a weak guide to that price.

title: Registration Opens for the 2026 .US Town Hall Featuring Internet Policy Pioneer Karen Rose
description: The 2026 .US Virtual Town Hall will bring together domain industry stakeholders on November 5, featuring Internet governance pioneer Karen Rose and discussions on domain policy, namespace security and community engagement.

title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
description: Clairic is a new model from Cloudflare that is a System One extraction modeI, capable of extracting, computing, estimating, and forecasting data from unstructured inputs.

title: London Ranks Last Among 18 European Capitals for Mobile Download Speeds
description: Ookla's latest benchmarking ranks London last among 18 European capitals for mobile download speeds, revealing persistent congestion, worsening latency and infrastructure constraints despite widespread 5G availability.

title: ICANN87 in Bali Puts DNS Abuse and New gTLD Implementation in Focus
description: ICANN87 in Bali brings DNS abuse mitigation, registrant protections and the next gTLD round into focus as policymakers examine implementation challenges affecting domain registries, registrars and Internet users.

title: DNS Spotlight: BigBear 2.0 PhaaS Targets Span 40+ Countries
description: An investigation into the BigBear 2.0 phishing operation examines 38 network indicators of compromise, identifying 81 potential victim IP addresses and more than 1,000 related domains through DNS, WHOIS and threat intelligence analysis.

title: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
description: CVE-2026-88771 lets attackers run commands on NetScaler Gateway before anyone signs in. Patching takes time most teams don't have, so the sign-in decision has to move in front of the vulnerable code.

title: Saving IPv4 Addresses on Interconnection with RFC8950
description: Many of us have been struggling with dual-stack IP address assignment on transfer networks. But what if we could reduce the work and concentrate on one IPv6 address per interconnection? Turns out, we already can. This article sheds some light on the practical implementation of RF…

title: INNOG 9 at APNIC 62: Building resilient infrastructure for the next Internet
description: INNOG 9, co-located with APNIC 62, offered a distinctly operational perspective, drawing on experiences from India and Bangladesh. Topics ranged from IPv6 deployment and submarine cable infrastructure, to lessons learned from Internet disruptions.

title: APNIC 62: Automation, trust, and the future of Internet infrastructure
description: At APNIC 62, keynote speakers Amajit Gupta and Yukako Uchida showed how the future Internet will depend on both autonomous, AI-driven networks and trusted human relationships.

title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
description: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.

title: Timor-Leste’s Internet ecosystem enters a new phase of development
description: As Timor-Leste deepens its integration with ASEAN and the global digital economy, continued progress in technical capability, resilience, and Internet governance will be critical to ensuring connectivity delivers broader economic and social benefits.

title: The RIPE Chair Team Reports - Looking Forward to RIPE 93
description: With less than two weeks to go until the RIPE 93 Meeting, preparations are well under way. Here is a preview of the programme, along with some practical reminders for everyone taking part.

title: [Podcast] The (dismal) economics of AI
description: As capital, labour, and energy are redirected towards AI infrastructure, the economic risks and consequences could be felt by investors, communities, and consumers worldwide. Geoff Huston discusses the economics of the AI investment boom.

title: Tips and Tricks for Making the Most of ARIN 58
description: ARIN 58 is almost here — and whether you’re joining us in Miami or signing on from your living room, a little preparation goes a long way. Here’s your TL;DR guide to everything you need to know before ARIN 58 kicks off next week on Thursday, 22 October.

title: Submarine cable resilience
description: The estimated 1.5M kilometres of subsea communications cables underpins our global telecommunication services. This critical infrastructure faces serious challenges in the coming years.

title: Moving Ideas into Action: The Next Chapter in ARIN Policy Engagement
description: The ARIN Advisory Council’s Policy Engagement Working Group shares its progress on implementing the results of the community engagement survey into tangible opportunities to participate in the Policy Development Process.

title: Resource delegation review update: Q3 2026
description: APNIC reported progress on the resource delegation review program at APNIC 62.

title: It’s Cybersecurity Awareness Month: When Did You Last Change Your Password?
description: October is Cybersecurity Awareness Month. ARIN Chief Information Security Officer Christian Johnson shares a quick reminder about the value of taking a few minutes to do some basic account housekeeping every now and then.

title: Get to Know the Draft Policies Up for Discussion at ARIN 58
description: Prepare for the upcoming meeting with this look at the Draft Policies on the agenda at ARIN 58, taking place 22-23 October in Miami, Florida, and online.

title: How to Propose and Read Draft Policy at ARIN
description: Anyone can help shape the policies that govern Internet number resources in the ARIN region. Here’s how to submit a policy proposal, read a Draft Policy page, and make your voice heard at our next Public Policy and Members Meeting.

title: Get Ready for ARIN Elections
description: The 2026 ARIN Elections are approaching, making this a good time to review the process and the participation opportunities available to you and your organization. Here’s a step-by-step guide to help you prepare to cast your vote this fall.

title: New features for RFC-Editor.org
description: New features implemented on RFC-Editor.org aim to make the site more useful and engaging for RFC consumers.

title: Restricting the Acquisition of Additional LIR Accounts
description: The RIPE NCC Executive Board has decided to temporarily restrict members' ability to acquire additional Local Internet Registry (LIR) accounts. Taking effect on Tuesday, 29 September, the restriction also covers requests already in progress. The decision is a first step towards a…

title: ARIN Bits: September 2026
description: The days may be shortening as we enter fall at ARIN HQ in Virginia, but we’re not slowing down the steady pace of changes, upgrades, and outreach that cropped up throughout July, August, and September. We’ve gathered the season’s key developments and upcoming opportunities in thi…

title: Meet the 2026 ARIN Community Grant Recipients
description: We would like to congratulate the organizations receiving funding from the ARIN Community Grant Program this year! Senior Project Manager Amanda Gauldin shares details about their projects.

title: PeeringDB Update April - September 2026
description: The last six months has seen important improvements to PeeringDB. We've added in page maps for searches of interconnection facilities and improved the data quality for AS-SET names.

title: The RIPE Chair Team Reports - September 2026
description: With RIPE 93 fast approaching, the RIPE Chair Team shares updates on policy and Working Group activity, the Code of Conduct Team document, and recent events across the Internet community.

title: Moving to a New Board Structure
description: A governance structure is strongest when the responsibilities written down on paper match the responsibilities exercised in practice. This proposal to change the RIPE NCC’s governance structure is intended to make sure that they do.

title: CAPIF 5: Regional Interconnectivity in Central Asia
description: Central Asia’s Internet looks very different than it did back at CAPIF 1. We trace the rise of direct regional routes, stronger routing security and new connectivity options - along with the gaps that remain.

title: IETF email infrastructure transition completed on 11 September
description: A transition to a new modern, modular, and containerized infrastructure for email services provided for ietf.org, iab.org, irtf.org, rfc-editor.org (including email lists) was completed on 11 September 2026.

title: The /3 Body Problem
description: A large chunk of IPv6 is heading for space, and every policy question about it is currently going to be deferred to the RIR communities. This article outlines what those questions look like, and argues why now is the time to start asking them.

title: Survey to gather input on ISE selection criteria
description: The Independent Series Editor (ISE) selection criteria survey is live and we welcome your input on the capabilities and expectations the IAB should consider when selecting a future ISE. Please respond by 11 October 2026.

title: Introducing the ARIN 58 Fellows
description: Amanda Gauldin, ARIN Senior Project Manager, shares details about the Fellows, Mentors, and special guests joining us for the ARIN 58 Fellowship Program.

title: Spurs boots VMware, cites 85% licensing saving
description: Part of wider infrastructure replacement upgrade project with HPE

title: IETF 126 Highlights
description: The IETF 126 meeting was held 18–24 July 2026 at the Hilton Vienna Park in Vienna, Austria, and online, hosted by Cisco. The week included the IETF Hackathon and Code Sprint, the New Participants' Program, five Birds-of-a-Feather (BoF) sessions, and more than 100 working group an…

title: Post-Quantum Authentication: Up Next
description: Post-quantum key establishment has moved from standards into deployment. Post-quantum authentication has not moved nearly as far, and specification work is no longer the only constraint. The IAB is holding a workshop in Prague on 11 and 12 October 2026 to bring deployment experie…

title: IETF 126 post-meeting survey: what we heard
description: The IETF 126 Vienna meeting was held 18-24 July 2026 and the results of the post-meeting survey are now available.

title: Meet our new IETF NOC Lead
description: Joe Clarke has been appointed as the new IETF Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead and in this post Joe introduces himself and sets out his priorities for the IETF Network.

title: Secretariat restructuring and staffing update
description: There have been a few changes in IETF Administration LLC staffing since January of this year (2026) including the recent insourcing of the Secretariat, which are summarised here to give an overall view of the staffing structure.

title: IETF Community Survey 2025
description: The IETF Community Survey provides a comprehensive assessment of community demographics, engagement patterns, and perceptions of organizational effectiveness. Read the full findings below.
